verses.text: A song of the stairway How joyous are those who love the Lord and bow low before God, ready to obey him!
Your reward will be prosperity, happiness, and well-being.
Your wife will bless your heart and home. Your children will bring you joy as they gather around your table.
Yes, this is God’s generous reward for those who love him.
May the Lord bless you out of his Zion-glory! May you see the prosperity of Jerusalem throughout your lifetime.
And may you be surrounded by your grandchildren. Happiness to you! And happiness to Israel!
